name: Efficient
rationale: Admission panel and film; the film shows coarse basophilic stippling; a targeted remedy history releases H15; blood lead confirms. The case must show: stippling on the film; H15 only on a specific supplement or remedy question; blood lead 121.2 ug/dL

name: Myelodysplasia with ring sideroblasts
rationale: Age 58, ring sideroblasts and the marrow report's own mention of a myelodysplastic syndrome. The case must show: mild dyserythropoiesis only; normal karyotype, FISH and myeloid panel; copper, B6 and zinc normal; no alcohol; no culprit drugs

name: Haemolytic anaemia
rationale: Reticulocytes 7.94%, bilirubin 24 umol/L with direct 2. The case must show: DAT negative; LDH moderately raised; haptoglobin low-normal; no spherocytes or fragments; no haemoglobinuria

name: Liver disease or herb-induced liver injury
rationale: AST 139, ALT 146, ALP 156 U/L, although the text calls the liver tests normal. The case must show: viral and autoimmune markers negative; synthetic function normal; ultrasound normal; the enzymes stay unexplained (decision D4)

name: Nutritional anaemia
rationale: Desquamation of the tongue and oral mucosa after years of metformin. The case must show: B12 low-normal, active B12 and folate normal; no intrinsic factor antibodies; mixed diet; anaemia not macrocytic

name: Upper gastrointestinal cause of pain after meals
rationale: Two weeks of post-prandial abdominal pain with reduced intake. The case must show: soft abdomen; lipase normal; H. pylori negative; imaging normal; endoscopy non-specific

name: Acute porphyria
rationale: Abdominal pain with anaemia. The case must show: porphobilinogen not in the acute range; ALA and urinary coproporphyrin raised; faecal porphyrins normal; ALA dehydratase activity low

name: Thalassaemia trait or red cell enzyme disorder
rationale: Basophilic stippling with a low-normal MCH and a reticulocytosis. The case must show: HPLC normal; no family history; G6PD normal; pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase low because lead inhibits it, which can mislead

name: Diabetes or thyroid disease as the explanation
rationale: Poorly controlled diabetes after stopping metformin and treated hypothyroidism. The case must show: thyroid function normal on thyroxine; hyperglycaemia moderate; neither explains an anaemia with a reticulocytosis

name: Other metals in the remedy
rationale: Once the capsules are disclosed, mercury and arsenic are common in Ayurvedic preparations. The case must show: the patient's mercury, arsenic and cadmium within reference limits (decision D9); only lead was measured in the capsules

name: Blood loss
rationale: Anaemia in a 58-year-old woman. The case must show: postmenopausal with no bleeding; no melaena or haematemesis; FIT negative; iron replete; colonoscopy normal
